blocks.text: Polymers bohat bare molecules hain jo bohat se chhote molecules, jinhein monomers kehte hain, ko polymerisation ke zariye jor kar bante hain. Organic polymers bari ahmiyat wale jadeed maadde hain: in ki khasiyaton aur kam qeemat ne zindagi aasan aur behtar banai hai. Polymers har jagah hain, shopping bags (poly(ethene)) aur kapre sukhane ki rassi (poly(propene)) se le kar bulletproof jackets (Kevlar) aur hawai sanat ke maaddon tak.

Polymers ki khasiyatein monomers ki qism aur tadaad aur un ke banane ke tareeqe se badalti hain. Kuch, jaise poly(ethene) aur poly(propene), halke aur naram hain aur naram maaddon wale kaamon ke liye munasib hain. Doosre, jaise Kevlar, sakht aur garmi mein bohat mustahkam hain aur sakht, der pa maaddon ke taur par use hote hain, maslan bulletproof jackets mein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein: polymers ke systematic naam
blocks.text: Masnoo polymers ke naam monomer ke naam se pehle 'poly' likh kar rakhe jate hain: polythene poly(ethene) aur polyvinyl chloride poly(chloroethene) hai. Do ya zyada monomers wale polymers ke liye aam naam use hote hain kyunke systematic naam bohat lamba hota hai: poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) ko polyethylene terephthalate, PET (PETE), kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Chloroethene se bane polymer ka systematic naam batayein.

items: Polymers: bohat se monomers se bane bare molecules.
Naam 'poly(monomer)'; lambe naamon ki jagah aam naam (PET).
